pages.text: There is no minimap. $(bold)Map Atlases$() collects maps into one book: craft an atlas from a book and a compass, feed it empty maps, carry it, and it fills as you travel. $(bold)M$() opens it; $(bold)P$() drops a pin where you stand.
pages.title: The atlas

pages.text: Mark deposits, villages, docks and boss structures. Different map scales zoom the atlas. A shared atlas on a lectern in the capital is the server's map room.$(br2)Supplementaries' $(bold)globe$() and Create's $(bold)schematics$() are the other two kinds of map: the world's shape, and a build's.
